content: We present a multi-task learning architecture to learn NMT for search query translation. As the motivating task is CLIR, we evaluated the ranking effectiveness of our proposed architecture. We used sentences from the target side of the parallel corpus as queries to retrieve relevant document and use terms from those documents to train a word embedding model along with NMT. One big challenge in this landscape is to sample meaningful queries from sentences as sentences do not directly convey information need. In the future, we hope to learn models that are able to sample search queries or information needs from sentences and use the output of that model to get relevant documents.
